name: Juniper Quinn
presence: Juniper Quinn sells futures from a counter of black glass. Her smile reaches everything but her eyes.
greeting: If it has a price, it is already on the slate. If it does not, they cannot afford the conversation.

wafer.gist: Black wafer, eighteen scrip. Half a key and a whole alibi. The other half is white and sulking in a well, if the rumors still pay rent.

gloves.gist: Insulated gloves, fourteen scrip. The rooftop cable is not a metaphor. There is also a pair under a drone, if they prefer violence to retail.

spire.gist: You sell the piece, not the ending. Endings ruin repeat business.

ash.gist: ASH is a customer who never paid her last invoice. If they work for her, charge double; she can afford a city.

combat.onDeathSay: Juniper falls across her own slate. The bazaar inhales and decides it saw nothing. Her stock is suddenly a public resource.
